pendencias.temaUnico: Only the dark theme exists. The old stylesheet still has 511 colours outside the tokens, and a light theme that paints half the screen would be worse than none. The migration is planned as V7-K.

contaSemNome: Your session has no name on record.
usoErro: Could not read the usage right now.
usoSemMedicao: This FRIGG is set up without the service that measures route, usage and cost. There is no number to show, and inventing one would be worse.
usoNaoPrecificadas: {n} call(s) with no price configured — their cost is NOT in this total.

usoVeredito.semConsumo: No calls recorded in this workspace yet.
usoVeredito.custoExcedido: The cost ceiling was reached. External routes stay blocked until the ceiling is revised.
usoVeredito.semPrecoExcedido: There were too many calls with no price configured. Set the route prices so the ceiling can measure again.
usoVeredito.naoSei: There is no measurement available to say whether this workspace is within any ceiling.

usoLimitacao: Subscription quota and provider-reported cost do not exist in this product. What is here is the usage FRIGG measured.

atalhosNomes.fechar: Close whatever is open — menu, modal or panel

atalhosLimitacao: These are all the shortcuts that exist today. There is no way to change the keys, and a shortcut listed here is always a shortcut that works.
dadosExplicacao: A JSON file with your tasks, their conversations, the descriptions, the plans, the attempts and the evidence — everything in this workspace's scope, and nothing outside it.
dadosLimitacao: The code your tasks generated is NOT in this file: it lives in the Library, with a cryptographic digest and its own download. Deleting data from here does not exist — deleting is a destructive action and depends on a decision by the product's owner.
dadosSemSegredo: No password, key or secret goes into the file. FRIGG does not keep any of them in this place.
idiomaAjuda: Changing the language only changes what is written on the screen. It does not change currency, price, permissions, tasks, history or the time of your scheduled runs.
idiomaCobertura: For now, the navigation and this Preferences screen are in all three languages. The other screens are still in Brazilian Portuguese and are being translated screen by screen — claiming everything is translated before that would be false.
idiomaNaoGuardado: Your choice could not be saved in this browser, so it only lasts until you close the page.
